name: Odeta
source:
"Look at this cool shell I found."

Odeta is Ankora's very, very, very distant cousin. There's nothing she loves more than something shiny. A soft-spoken daydreamer.

[From [url=https://lovelandisle.itch.io/love-in-a-bottle]itch.io[/url]]
